extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.
NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sets material requirements for equipment used in H2S-containing oil and gas production.

faqs.q: What is a compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves used for?
faqs.a: Low-height hydraulic actuators for API 6A gate valves where space is tight: offshore platforms, frac wellheads, test trees, integrated wellheads; 3,000 psi, fail-close or fail-open.

faqs.q: Do PSL levels apply to a compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A valves?
faqs.a: No. The listing states that PSL does not apply to actuators; the PSL stays with the valve the actuator is fitted to. The actuator carries pressure and function tests, plus a combined valve-and-actuator test.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressure ratings does the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves come in?
faqs.a: The listing covers Fitted to API 6A gate valves nominal bore at 3,000 psi control pressure, with bonnet-mounted on the valve. Give the bore, working pressure and end connection on the enquiry and we match the exact model.

faqs.q: When should I choose a compact hydraulic actuator instead of a standard single-acting actuator?
faqs.a: Choose the compact type where headroom is tight, such as offshore platforms, frac wellheads, test trees and integrated wellheads. For SSV duty with PR2F see the [single-acting hydraulic actuator](/p/hydraulic-single-acting-actuator-api-6a).

faqs.q: How is the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves tested?
faqs.a: For the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves (Fitted to API 6A gate valves, 3,000 psi control pressure): actuator pressure and function tests, and a combined valve-and-actuator test when supplied together. The test record is supplied with the valve. Shell and seat tests are proof tests and are never working pressures.

faqs.q: Which material and temperature classes does the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves offer?
faqs.a: On the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves, body material is offered in API 6A material classes AA, BB, CC, and the temperature range is -29 °C to 121 °C. For sour service the DD to HH classes apply to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. Give your temperature and H2S data on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Is the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves to API specification, and what documents are supplied?
faqs.a: The compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves is built to API 6A by API-licensed manufacturers and supplied with the API certificate and monogram documentation. Material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records and the test record come with it, and operator specifications are reviewed clause by clause.

faqs.q: How is the compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves operated?
faqs.a: The compact hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves is operated by hydraulic, fail close or fail open. It is a spring-return piston that fails closed or open depending on the spring arrangement ordered. End connections on the listing are bonnet-mounted on the valve.

faqs.q: How does a compact spring-return hydraulic actuator fail safe?
faqs.a: Control pressure compresses the spring and holds the gate in position; when pressure is lost the spring returns the valve to the fail position, fail close or fail open as ordered. The control pressure is 3,000 psi.

faqs.q: Compact hydraulic actuator or double-acting actuator for a gate valve?
faqs.a: A compact actuator is a low-height spring-return piston for tight spaces, while a standard single-acting actuator is taller and suits wellhead SSVs and pipeline valves. See the [Hydraulic Single-Acting Actuator for API 6A Gate Valves](/p/hydraulic-single-acting-actuator-api-6a).

faqs.q: Do PSL levels apply to a double-acting hydraulic actuator?
faqs.a: No. The listing states that PSL does not apply to actuators; the PSL of the valve it is fitted to applies. Actuator pressure and function tests, and a combined valve-and-actuator test, are carried out.

faqs.q: How is the double-acting hydraulic actuator for API 6A gate valves operated?
